# Joplin OneNote test samples

These 37 section and notebook-table files were vendored into the `onenote.rs` parser test corpus from Joplin. The vendoring commit is `3011a1f0f2a13288aa8ac366f783adc0673e4989` in `msiemens/onenote.rs`. The upstream notice in `LICENSE` credits `https://github.com/laurent22/` and identifies AGPL-3.0-or-later terms. The full AGPL text is included as `LICENSE-AGPL-3.0.txt`.

This folder contains 22 `.one` files and 15 `.onetoc2` files, unchanged. `SHA256SUMS.txt` records the file hashes; non-ASCII path segments are UTF-8 percent-encoded. These are external test data only. No Joplin or onenote.rs parser code is included.

The upstream Joplin license notice applies specifically to this test-data subtree. Keep it and the full AGPL license with these files when redistributing them. See the parent README for the onenote.rs source revision and corpus context.

Sources:

- [Joplin repository](https://github.com/laurent22/joplin)
- [onenote.rs vendoring commit](https://github.com/msiemens/onenote.rs/commit/3011a1f0f2a13288aa8ac366f783adc0673e4989)
- [GNU AGPL version 3 text](https://www.gnu.org/licenses/agpl-3.0.html)
